import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int Maxn = 5500;
    static final int Maxm = 35500;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class LinkNode {
        int nxt, t, c, l;
        LinkNode(int nxt, int t, int c, int l) {
            this.nxt = nxt;
            this.t = t;
            this.c = c;
            this.l = l;
        }
    }

    static LinkNode[] adj = new LinkNode[Maxm];
    static int[] head = new int[Maxn];
    static int edgeCount = 1;

    static int S, T;
    static int[] preNode = new int[Maxn];
    static int[] linkPos = new int[Maxn];
    static int[] flowVal = new int[Maxn];
    static int[] dist = new int[Maxn];
    static boolean[] inQ = new boolean[Maxn];

    static class Data {
        int f, t;
        Data(int f, int t) {
            this.f = f;
            this.t = t;
        }
    }

    static int[][] pl = new int[105][105];
    static int[][] st = new int[105][105];
    static Data[] s = new Data[105];

    static int n, m, k, C, D;
    static int[][] p = new int[105][105];
    static int[][] stArr = new int[105][105];

    static int P(int x, int y) {
        return x * n + y;
    }

    static void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) {
        adj[++edgeCount] = new LinkNode(head[from], to, capacity, cost);
        head[from] = edgeCount;
        adj[++edgeCount] = new LinkNode(head[to], from, 0, -cost);
        head[to] = edgeCount;
    }

    static int spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0, T + 1, INF);
        Arrays.fill(flowVal, 0, T + 1, 0);
        flowVal[S] = INF;
        dist[S] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(S);
        inQ[S] = true;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQ[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = adj[i].nxt) {
                int v = adj[i].t;
                if (adj[i].c > 0 && dist[v] > dist[u] + adj[i].l) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + adj[i].l;
                    flowVal[v] = Math.min(flowVal[u], adj[i].c);
                    linkPos[v] = i;
                    preNode[v] = u;
                    if (!inQ[v]) {
                        inQ[v] = true;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return flowVal[T];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        C = sc.nextInt();
        D = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < Maxn; i++) {
            head[i] = 0;
        }
        edgeCount = 1;

        S = P(n + k, n) + 1;
        T = S + 1;

        addEdge(P(0, 1), T, INF, 0);

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int pVal = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(S, P(0, pVal), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int f1 = sc.nextInt();
            int t1 = sc.nextInt();
            s[i * 2 - 1] = new Data(f1, t1);
            s[i * 2] = new Data(t1, f1);
        }
        m *= 2;

        for (int t = 1; t <= n + k; t++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                addEdge(P(t - 1, i), P(t, i), INF, 0);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                addEdge(P(t - 1, s[i].f), P(t, s[i].t), 1, D);
                pl[t][i] = 0; // placeholder, will be set later
                st[t][i] = 1;
            }
            addEdge(P(t, 1), T, INF, t * C);
        }

        int totalFlow = 0;
        int totalCost = 0;

        while (true) {
            int flow_now = spfa();
            if (flow_now == 0) break;
            int u = T;
            while (u != S) {
                int last = preNode[u];
                adj[linkPos[u]].c -= flow_now;
                adj[linkPos[u] ^ 1].c += flow_now;
                u = last;
            }
            totalCost += dist[T] * flow_now;

            for (int t = 1; t <= n + n; t++) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                    if (adj[linkPos(P(t, s[i].f))].c > 0) {
                        st[t][i]++;
                        int costVal = D * (st[t][i] * 2 - 1);
                        addEdge(P(t - 1, s[i].f), P(t, s[i].t), 1, costVal);
                        pl[t][i] = 0; // placeholder, can be set as needed
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(totalCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
